title.zh: DeepSeek's New Model Nearly Matches GPT-6 Astra on Design—at 1.4% of the Cost
title.en: DeepSeek's New Model Nearly Matches GPT-6 Astra on Design—at 1.4% of the Cost

current_state.zh: DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash scored 81.2 on OpenDesign Arena's real-world design benchmark—98% of GPT-6 Astra's 82.7—while costing roughly 1.4% as much per completed design.
